name: B10-0148/2025 (Renew) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a major increase in Europe's defence efforts. It asks for much more money for defence and for military support to Ukraine, and for European countries to buy more defence equipment together. It wants the EU to prepare for extreme military situations, produce weapons faster, and rely less on other countries. The text is a set of requests and opinions, not a law, so nothing changes yet.

- What changes: nothing yet; it asks for higher defence spending, more arms for Ukraine and joint EU defence projects.
- Who it affects: EU governments, the defence industry, Ukraine and European taxpayers.
- What happens next: the EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
